steps.name: Infected Patrol Unit
steps.text: Nggaaaaah!

steps.name: Infected Patrol Unit
steps.text: Aahh... aaaaaahh!

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Talulah...! You... ngh...!

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Is that fire your doing!? You're the one who set them alight... guh!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Alina, I'm sorry. This will surely mean even worse to come for the village. But I just couldn't stand it.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I just couldn't stand this sort of...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: ...Alina?
Facing her, Talulah was taken aback. Alina met her gaze with an expression she'd never seen her wear before.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: There's a fire in your eyes.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: I knew from the moment you came to this village, you'd never be willing just to stay here.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: You came from somewhere. Where you came from, you'll go back to. This village can't hold you.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I won't go back. Don't look at me like that...

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: But within your eyes, truly, there's a fire.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: You wanted to set something alight, burn it away, you thought none of this was how it should be, you bore it until you could bear it no more...

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: It shouldn't have been now, Talulah. Not now.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: The villagers are innocent. Your one flare of anger only served to hurt them.

steps.name: Infected Patrol Unit
steps.text: What happened—oh, God! What the hell is going on?! Who!? Who did this!?

steps.name: Old Woman
steps.text: Talulah! Talulah! Run, now, run! And don't look back! Don't ever come back!

steps.name: Old Woman
steps.text: Blessings, your Majesty, bless this girl like my daughter, bless her to live on, bless her so she can live on!

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Talulah, we need to go!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: No... those hideous patrolmen!

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: We're Infected, but none of the villagers are!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: ...What did you say?

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: I'm Infected too, Talulah. I'm Infected too.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: *Pant*, *pant*... This is... where we'd planned to move. We had everything ready... but...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: They... The old man was...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: We can't let them do this again... we can't let them...

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: He saved you, saved me, saved the whole village.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: You threw... his whole plan into disarray.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: What do you even mean? The villagers were the ones who—

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: ...Wait. You mean the one who turned him in... was...

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: It was his idea. That way, the Patrol wouldn't come again, and hopefully, that would've been that.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: No matter how much strength you have, you can't resist the Patrol Unit.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I can.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: And then? What if the Gendarmerie came? What if the city's garrisons and all the nobles' soldiers came?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: We just don't have the firepower. Once we've accumulated enough strength...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Because it's not right. It's not right! We can't just look on like this!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: All these wicked things right before our eyes, but we turn away, just to save ourselves?! That's not right!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: ...That's selfish. Heartless, even.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: If righteousness can only be upheld by greater and greater violence, how can it even be considered righteous?

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: I can't answer these questions of yours, Talulah. You've studied more than I have, that I know.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: But someone died today in the village. And no more ought to die.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: You're so clever. You can understand that.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Now, go, Talulah!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: ...I'll be back.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Tell yourself that, Talulah. Tell yourself that.
